dsvAccount.description: Shipper's DSV account number. The account must be a valid DSV account number that is active.

dimensionUnit.description: Unit of measurement for dimensions. Could be CM - centimeter or IN - inch

weightUnit.description: Weight unit of measurement. Could be KG - Kilogram or LBS - Pound

packages.description: Packages information. For Envelope shipment only one package is allowed.

carrierTrackingNumber.description: Shipment carrier tracking number. Useful when creating shipment already booked to carrier.

state.description: Identifying abbreviation for US state, Canada province, Ireland county, etc. Format and presence of this field will vary, depending on country.

contactPhoneNumber.description: Contact Phone Number, format is : +(optionnal)DDDD (one space required) DDDDDDDDD

residential.description: This element is only used in Delivery Address to identify if this address is residential

registrationNumbers.description: List of registration numbers. Only one registration number is permitted for now.

qualifier.description:
Registration Number Qualifiers : 
  * EORI - European Union Registration and Identification

requestPickup.description: `true` by default. If `false`, no pickup will be requested.

collectDateFrom.description:
Collect Date From (local time). Mandatory if pickup is requested. Should match the real pickup time slot.
Expected date format : yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.
Be aware that you may encounter date format errors if you use the definition file to generate source code. Indeed date libraries can vary from one language to another.

collectDateTo.description:
Collect Date To (local time). Mandatory if pickup is requested.
Expected date format : yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.
Be aware that you may encounter date format errors if you use the definition file to generate source code. Indeed date libraries can vary from one language to another.

Pickup.description: Container for the pickup information. If address is left empty, shipment will be picked-up up at `sender` address.

splitDutyVATIndicator.description: Split Duty VAT Indicator. `false` by default. If `true` the payer specified for freight charges will pay transportation charges and any duties that apply to the shipment. The payer specified for Duties and Taxes will pay the VAT (Value Added Tax) only.

paymentType.description: Billed party. Could be SENDER / RECEIVER / DELIVERY / THIRD_PARTY

accountNumber.description: Carrier account number of the payer.

accountZipCode.description: Carrier account postal code of the payer.

iossNumber.description: Mandatory if origin is outside of EU and destination EU and shipping to end consumer and value is equal or below 150 euros. (only applicable to dutiesAndTaxesPayment)

iossExempt.description: IOSS Exempt indicator (true if not shipping to an end consumer, and/or the commodities value exceeds 150 euros). (only applicable to dutiesAndTaxesPayment)

serviceCode.description:
List of DSV service:
 * DSVAirExpress (default service if not provided)
 * DSVAirExpressImport
 * DSVParcels
 * DSVParcelsImport
 * DSVEconomy
 * DSVEconomyImport
 * DsvCrossTrade
 * DsvCrossTradeEconomy
 * DSVSpecialService
 * DSVSpecialServiceImport

timeOption.description: Delivery Time Option, could be 9AM, 1030AM or 12PM

saturdayDelivery.description: Saturday delivery. `false` by default. If `true`, saturday delivery is requested.

ServiceOptions.description:
Container for shipment service options.
Note: You may be subject to automatic insurance based on your account configuration.

ExtraOption.description: Extra option required by specific carrier and service combinations

PackageType.description: Package type. Could be PARCELS / DOCUMENT / ENVELOPE. PARCELS by default.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method. Could be CASH / CHECK

ServiceOptionsCod.description: Container for Cash On Delivery information. The presence indicates COD is requested.

carrierAccountNumber.description: Carrier account number that should be used for booking.

CarrierCodeList.description: Contact your DSV representative to know possible value

length.description: Package length. Length must be the longest dimension of the container. Dimensions may be mandatory depending on your country

width.description: Package width. Dimensions may be mandatory depending on your country

height.description: Package height. Dimensions may be mandatory depending on your country

stackableTimes.description: Number of time a package can be stacked.

carrierTrackingNumber.description: Package carrier tracking number. Useful when creating shipment already booked to carrier.

content.description:
Type of regulated good. Supported codes:
 * `ADR` - Transport of dangerous goods by road
 * `ADR_LQ` - Transport of dangerous goods by road in limited quantities
 * `DGR` - Transport of dangerous goods by Air (IATA regulations)
 * `LITHIUM` - Transport of goods consisting of or containing Lithium Batteries
 * `EXQ` - Transport of dangerous goods in Excepted Quantities
 * `DRY_ICE` - Transport of cargo containing Dry Ice

SpecialCargo.description:
Container for special cargo content's information.
* Please note that one shipment should hold only one type of 'special cargo content'.
* Only one type of 'special cargo content' is supported per shipment. It is not allowed to mix different types.
* In one shipment, you can mix 'special cargo content' packages and non-regulated packages.

UNNumber.description: UN class of the regulated good

packingGroup.description: Packing group associated to the specific commodity. Could be '' / I / II / III

weight.description: The weight of the regulated good. Should be inferior to package gross weight.

idgPackageType.description: The type of package used to contain the regulated good

idgProperShippingName.description: The proper shipping name assigned by ADR or IATA

SpecialCargoDangerousGoods.description: Container for Dangerous Goods' information. Required if `content` is DGR or ADR

weight.description: The weight of the dry ice. Should be inferior to package gross weight.

SpecialCargoDryIce.description: Container for Dry Ice's information. Required if `content` is DRY_ICE

weight.description: The weight of the regulated good. Should be inferior to package gross weight.

UNNumber.description: UN class of the regulated good

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure of the regulated good

SpecialCargoAdrLq.description: Container for ADR LQ's information. Required if `content` is ADR_LQ

category.description:
Category of Lithium Battery that will be shipped (different categories cannot be shipped in same shipment) valid values are :
 * SII-966
 * SII-967
 * SII-969
 * SII-970
 * SI-966
 * SI-969
 * SI-967
 * SI-970 
 * SIA-965
 * SIB-965
 * SIA-968
 * SIB-968

SpecialCargoLithium.description: Container for Lithium's information. Required if `content` is LITHIUM

mrn.description: Movement Reference Number (MRN) information. Valid format (A=AlphaNumeric, C=Char) AACCAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

notificationCode.description:
Type of notification to subscribe:
 * `DEP` - Departure notifications
 * `DEL` - Delivery notifications
 * `EXC` - Exception notifications
 * `DOC` - Document notifications

recipients.description: List of recipient email addresses separated by `,`

language.description:
Notification language (English by default):
 * DE - German
 * EN - English
 * ES - Spanish
 * FR - French
 * IT - Italian
 * NL - Dutch

qualifier.description:
Reference Qualifiers :
 * PURCHASE_ORDER - Purchase Order Reference
 * CUSTOMS_DEC - Customs Declaration N°
 * SHPR_REF - Shipper reference
 * CNEE_REF - Delivery reference
 * COM_INV - Commercial Invoice N°
 * CARRIER_REF - Carrier reference N°
 * DELIVERY_NOTE - Delivery note
 * SHIPMENT_LOADING_REF - Shipment loading reference
 * SHIPMENT_BARCODE - Shipment barcode

incoterm.description:
Code of incoterm :
 * DDP
 * DAP (default value if not provided)
 * DAT
 * CIP
 * CPT
 * FCA
 * EXW

typeOfExport.description:
Type of export :
 * PERMANENT - Permanent (default value if not provided)
 * TEMPORARY - Temporary
 * RE_EXPORT - Re-Export (repair and/or return)

exportReason.description:
Export reason :
 * SOLD - Sold (default value if not provided)
 * NOT_SOLD - Not Sold
 * PERS_EFFECT - Personnal effects
 * REP_RET - Repair and Return
 * SAMPLE - Sample
 * GIFT - Gift

mrn.description: Movement Reference Number (MRN) information. Valid format (A=AlphaNumeric, C=Char) AACCAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

ProformaInvoiceTypeList.description: Type of the invoice, Proforma or Commercial. Could be COMMERCIAL / PROFORMA

shipmentId.description: ID of shipment to upload a document

description.description: Description of the file to upload
Description of the file to upload

mimeType.description:
Mime Type. Could be:
 * application/pdf
 * application/msword
 * application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
 * application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text
 * application/vnd.ms-excel
 * application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
 * application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet
 * text/csv
 * image/png
 * image/jpeg

ShipmentDocumentTypeList.description:
Shipment Document Type. Could be:
 * PROFORMA_INVOICE
 * COMMERCIAL_INVOICE
 * CUSTOMS_DECLARATION
 * CERTIFICATE_OF_ORIGIN
 * PACKING_LISTADR
 * BANK_DOCUMENTS
 * DG_GOODS_DECLARATION
 * OTHERS
 * PICKUP_ORDER
 * EXPORT_DECLARATION
 * EXPORT_ATTACHMENT

trackingNumber.description: Package carrier tracking number, can be empty if carrier tracking number exists only at shipment level, and if document contains labels for several packages.

barcode.description:
The main barcode printed on the label.

_NOTE: for Shipments booked with DPD, this might contain only partial data_

format.description: Label format (PDF / ZPL). The format used in label request is returned.

documentType.description:
Document Type. Could be:
 * DOCUMENT_TYPE_CARRIER_MANIFEST
 * DOCUMENT_TYPE_CARRIER_CONSIGNMENT_NOTE
 * DOCUMENT_TYPE_TURN_IN_COPY

monetaryValue.description: Charge value amount. Amount is expressed exclusive tax.
Total charges value amount. Amount is expressed exclusive tax.

Currency Code supported (EUR by default if not provided):
 * CAD -  Canadian Dollar
 * CNY  - Yuan Renminbi
 * DKK  - Danish Krone
 * EUR  - Euro
 * GBP  - British Pound
 * HKD  - Hong Kong Dollar
 * NOK  - Norwegian Krone
 * SEK  - Swedish krona
 * SGD  - Singapore Dollar
 * USD  - Dollar
 * ZAR  - Rand

carrierCode.description:
Some supported carriers:

ExportCompliance.description: Compliance data required by some trade and customs authorities
